provenance.matrixSource: Original UnityPy transform TRS plus exact controlled pose mutations in MeteorDynamicBoundsProbe. Matrix arithmetic reconstructed in float64; outputs are independent Unity-native bounds reads, not candidate outputs.
provenance.coordinateFrame: Unity to glTF X reflection: R*M*R; box center [-x,y,z], extents unchanged.
provenance.acceptance: Absolute 2e-6 model units; numeric algorithm regression, not bitwise native arithmetic or native sort-position certification.

emptyBoxProvenance.matrixSource: Actual native rootWorld/boneWorld float32 readbacks from the same controlled native samples.
emptyBoxProvenance.policy: Infinity sentinel represented only by empty:true; array entry and sourceIndex0 preserved; original min/maxfloat bits retained as hex strings in provenance.

trailingBoneProvenance.matrixSource: Actual native firstN boneWorld and rootWorld float32 readbacks.
trailingBoneProvenance.policy: BoneAABB count equals bindPose count; firstN box i uses original renderer.bones[i]. Extra trailing bones have no bounds boxes and are not synthesized.
